--batch.Name: --batch
--batch.description: Do not do interactive display; implies -q

--bg-daemon.Name: --bg-daemon
--bg-daemon.description: Start a server in the background

--daemon.Name: --daemon
--daemon.description: Start a server in the background

--debug-init.Name: --debug-init
--debug-init.description: Enable Emacs Lisp debugger during the processing of the user init file ~/.emacs.  This is useful for debugging problems in the init file

--fg-daemon.Name: --fg-daemon
--fg-daemon.description: Start a server in the foreground

--file.Name: --file
--file.description: The same as specifying file directly as an argument

--find-file.Name: --find-file
--find-file.description: The same as specifying file directly as an argument

--no-desktop.Name: --no-desktop
--no-desktop.description: Do not load a saved desktop

--no-init-file.Name: --no-init-file
--no-init-file.description: Do not load an init file

--no-site-file.Name: --no-site-file
--no-site-file.description: Do not load the site-wide startup file

--no-splash.Name: --no-splash
--no-splash.description: Do not display a splash screen during start-u

--quick.Name: --quick
--quick.description: Similar to "-q --no-site-file --no-splash",  Also, avoid processing X resources

--terminal.Name: --terminal
--terminal.description: Use specified file as the terminal instead of using stdin/stdout.  This must be the first argument specified in the command line

--version.Name: --version
--version.description: Display Emacs version information and exit

--visit.Name: --visit
--visit.description: The same as specifying file directly as an argument

-Q.Name: -Q
-Q.description: Similar to "-q --no-site-file --no-splash",  Also, avoid processing X resources

-nsl.Name: -nsl
-nsl.description: Do not load the site-wide startup file

-q.Name: -q
-q.description: Do not load an init file

-t.Name: -t
-t.description: Use specified file as the terminal instead of using stdin/stdout.  This must be the first argument specified in the command line
